top5.summary_zh: 苹果研究团队在arXiv提交论文《Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation》，披露人形机器人自主控制系统HALO，并公开数据生成、模型训练和部署代码。落地阶段采用宇树科技G1人形机器人，背部加装3D打印保护外壳并内置一台Mac mini（M4 Pro，64GB统一内存），负责机载实时推理Orchestrator（VLM）与Motion Generator（DiT），G1板载芯片则专注高频运行Tracker（RL策略网络）。
top5.title_en: Apple details HALO humanoid robot system: uses Qwen model on Unitree G1, 91% average success on single tasks
top5.summary_en: Apple's research team submitted the paper "Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation" to arXiv, disclosing the HALO autonomous humanoid control system and releasing data generation, model training and deployment code. For deployment it used Unitree's G1 humanoid, adding a 3D-printed protective shell and an onboard Mac mini (M4 Pro, 64GB unified memory) for real-time inference of the Orchestrator (VLM) and Motion Generator (DiT), while the G1's onboard chip runs the high-frequency Tracker (RL policy network).
top5.what_zh: 据IT之家报道，苹果研究团队11月4日在arXiv提交论文《Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation》，披露人形机器人自主控制系统HALO，并公开数据生成、训练与部署代码。落地阶段采用宇树G1，背部加装3D打印外壳并内置Mac mini（M4 Pro，64GB）负责机载推理Orchestrator（VLM）与Motion Generator（DiT），G1板载芯片运行Tracker（RL策略网络）。
top5.what_en: Per IT之家, Apple researchers submitted an arXiv paper on Nov 4 detailing HALO, a humanoid autonomous control system, and released code for data generation, training and deployment. Deployment used a Unitree G1 with a 3D-printed back shell housing a Mac mini (M4 Pro, 64GB) for on-board inference of the Orchestrator (VLM) and Motion Generator (DiT), while the G1's own chip runs the Tracker (RL policy).
